Name: Cheaper Bug Steak
Author: BadMoonBeast
Description:
[i]Beast here again with more crap to bloat your Mods folder, this time I am being cheap with my Bug Meats.

[/i][b]What It Does:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changes Bug Steak recipe to require One, Three, or Five Bug Meats (configurable). Set it to "Ten" (or false, or whatever) to turn the mod off.
[/list]
Enjoy your buggy buffet!

I'm a lazy turd so the config only accepts written out numbers like that, so I [b]strongly recommend[/b] you get [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to make editing the config easier on yourself.

﻿[b]Please note[/b] that you will require [b]both[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] in order for this mod to work.

Manifest.Name: Cheaper Bug Steak
Manifest.Description: Makes bug steak cost less bug meats.
